title: Liquor smugglers use code names and clever hiding tricks to evade prohibition in Bihar
content: Smugglers in Bihar are becoming increasingly inventive in their methods to transport liquor despite prohibition. They employ coded phrases to substitute recognizable brand names in their communications for secrecy. Various creative concealment techniques are used, such as hiding liquor in snack items, medication containers, and altered vehicles. As they adapt to enforcement efforts, authorities grapple with the challenge of dismantling these elaborate smuggling operations.

title: Punjab's poll drug debate has old players in new roles: BJP, Cong attack; AAP defends
content: Gulzar Singh's alleged suicide has brought Punjab's drug problem back into the political spotlight ahead of the 2027 assembly elections. AAP now has nearly five years in office to defend, Congress is reviving its old attacks, and the BJP is making the issue a major part of its statewide push.

title: US labor dept hints at 'total shutdown' of H-1B visa program
content: Anthony D'Esposito, Inspector General at the Department of Labor, announced an investigation into the H-1B visa program. Investigators are focusing on fraud related to foreign labor, which may lead to significant reforms. D'Esposito indicated that the program could look very different in one year. The administration is also examining colleges allegedly exploiting J-1 visas, as part of a wider crackdown.

title: 14-year-old Georgia student scores perfect 1600 on SAT
content: At just 14 years old, Ashrit Talluri from Georgia has achieved remarkable success, scoring a flawless 1600 on the SAT exam. Having earned 14½ high school credits in middle school, he is now taking college-level courses as a ninth grader at Innovation Academy. With five months of meticulous preparation behind him, Ashrit dreams of becoming a neurosurgeon, eager to delve into projects that combine cutting-edge technology with healthcare.

title: Caesars Palace founder's Vegas estate listed for $1.997M after price cuts
content: Experience the allure of Las Vegas with this stunning estate that was once home to visionary casino mogul Jay Sarno. Priced at $1.997 million, this property boasts exquisite features such as a luxurious pool and guest house. Sarno's legacy lives on in this residence, intertwined with the glamorous history of the city and its iconic former inhabitants.

title: Bill Gates Foundation to shut down in 2045: Why some Americans reject its $400m ‘gift’
content: The Bill Gates Foundation is making a bold move by committing $1 billion to ensure equitable AI development for education and healthcare. Of this, $400 million is dedicated to creating AI-driven tutoring systems that tailor learning experiences. This investment arrives amidst rising discussions about digital tools' effectiveness and privacy issues, with New York City already enacting a one-year pause on generative AI in schools.

title: Katrina says mom left London for Tamil Nadu village to help kids
content: In 2008, Suzanne Turquotte relocated from London to Tamil Nadu with a mission to uplift local communities through her initiative, Relief Projects India. Initially providing free evening tuition for children, the organization broadened its scope to address a range of community needs. She also co-founded the Mountain View School, aiming to deliver English-language education to children in farming families.

title: Jason and Kylie Kelce’s $2.9B investment: How did it reach 5,000 stores?
content: Jason Kelce has made a savvy equity investment in Hank Sauce via Winnie Capital, marking a significant step for both him and the brand. Once a local staple, Hank Sauce now boasts distribution in over 5,000 stores across the country. With a U.S. hot sauce market worth nearly $2.9 billion, this partnership looks to amplify Hank Sauce's visibility and reach nationally, taking advantage of the substantial growth opportunities ahead.

title: Travis Kelce’s $12.35M real estate empire: How did he build it?
content: Travis Kelce has built an impressive real estate portfolio spanning Kansas and Ohio. His reported properties include a 17,000-square-foot Leawood mansion, a 21,000-square-foot lakefront estate in Bratenahl and a former 10,000-square-foot Kansas City home. Together, the three properties cover nearly 48,000 square feet, with reported purchase prices totalling about $12.35 million. His Leawood home also reportedly served as the setting for his 2025 proposal to Taylor Swift.

title: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan stuns in her royal avatar at Paris event - WATCH
content: Bollywood star Aishwarya Rai Bachchan attended an event in Paris and captivated audiences with her runway presence. She wore a dramatic velvet ensemble that complemented her bold hair color choice. Aishwarya was joined by various international celebrities, including Celine Dion and Eva Longoria, during the event. The actress shared joyous moments with her fellow stars, breaking into dance and sharing hugs.

title: Stock market rout: Sensex sinks to 6-month low, Rs 17 lakh crore wiped out in a month
content: The sell-off intensified on Monday. The BSE benchmark plunged 1,124.02 points, or 1.52%, to close at 72,771.72, marking its lowest closing level since March 30, 2026. The Nifty fell 360.25 points, or 1.56%, to finish at 22,780.25, its lowest level in nearly six months. The weakness was also visible beyond the frontline indices. The BSE SmallCap Select index fell 1.90%, while the MidCap Select index declined 1.39%.

title: Bigg Boss 20: Uditi Singh calls her breakup with ex Karan Wahi 'a blessing in disguise'
content: Uditi Singh has been discussing her past relationship with Karan Wahi and their subsequent breakup. She described the breakup as a blessing in disguise and noted it reshaped her career and personal life. Uditi revealed that their relationship strained after adopting a pet and issues surrounding cleanliness arose. She also mentioned her mother's disapproval of their age gap affecting their dynamic.

title: Another child rape case against granite baron Veeramani 12 years after girl’s suicide
content: R Veeramani, previously arrested in a child rape case, has been charged with another incident. This new charge relates to the suicide of a 16-year-old girl in 2014, prompting her mother to file a complaint. The case remained dormant due to police record loss after a fire. The special investigation team is now looking into both incidents and collecting evidence from the public.

title: Gautam Adani, 4 group firms settle with Sebi in minimum public shareholding violation case
content: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani and his companies have reached a settlement with Sebi regarding violations of minimum public shareholding laws. They agreed to pay Rs 1.48 crore to close the matter, which stemmed from complaints filed in 2020. Although the involved parties denied any wrongdoing, Sebi will refrain from further enforcement actions unless similar issues come up in the future.

title: India realty sees record $9.5bn equity inflow in Q3: Report
content: India's real estate landscape experienced an unprecedented surge in equity investment, hitting $9.5 billion in the September 2026 quarter, a staggering increase from last year's $4.4 billion. Data centres accounted for 57 percent of these inflows, illustrating a pivotal change in investment strategy. Furthermore, foreign investors contributed nearly 59 percent, indicating a strong global appetite for Indian real estate.

title: Mumbai Police adds a road safety twist to Ranbir Kapoor's 'Love & War' first-look:
content: In an imaginative twist, Mumbai Police showcased Ranbir Kapoor's first-look poster for 'Love & War', emphasizing the critical importance of seat belt usage. Their social media strategy cleverly links the film's title with this life-saving safety reminder, capturing public attention. Anticipation grows among fans eager to see Ranbir, Alia Bhatt, and Vicky Kaushal share the screen for the first time.

title: Once known for tree-lined avenues, craters define these posh areas in Bhopal now
content: BHEL township in Bhopal has experienced severe damage to roads due to recent monsoon rainfall. Residents are now navigating potholes, muddy stretches, and waterlogged patches daily. Commuters have reported increased vehicle breakdowns and accidents related to these conditions. While civic agencies promise repairs, residents find temporary fixes insufficient for long-term relief. There are urgent calls for comprehensive solutions to restore safety and the area's reputation.

title: 'Leave us alone': 3 students say LPU posted rape 'truth' video without consent
content: Three female students from Lovely Professional University stated that a video of them was released without their consent. This video allegedly dismissed claims of a rape incident on campus involving a plumber. Following the allegations, students protested and vandalized property and blocked a highway for over 15 hours.

title: Shaili Singh's long jump mark wrongly measured by officials, will move CAS: AFI
content: Shaili Singh finished fourth with a best jump of 6.42m on Sunday. India's Ancy Sojan won silver with 6.53m, while China's Huang Yingying took gold with 6.55m on her final attempt. The controversy centres on Shaili's fourth attempt, which was officially measured at 6.41m.

title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India’s 8-medal haul, boxing assures more
content: India has made remarkable strides in the Asian Games 2026, gathering a total of eight medals in athletics, shooting, and kurash. Notably, Yashvir Singh and Rohit Yadav achieved a spectacular javelin double, while Murali Sreeshankar secured a silver in the long jump. Contributions from Esha Singh and Pincky Balhara, who earned silver and bronze medals respectively, further bolstered the nation's success.

title: Asian Games Medal Tally: India win 8 medals but remain outside top 10
content: India won eight medals on Day 9 of the Asian Games, including four silver and four bronze. Notable performances included Yashvir Singh and Rohit Yadav securing silver and bronze in the men's javelin. Esha Singh earned silver in the women's 25m pistol, while several athletes contributed to the medal tally across different sports. Despite the successes, India's gold medal count remained at four, keeping it in 12th place overall.

title: Homebuyers, take note: These Indian cities saw housing sales rise in Q3
content: During the July to September quarter of 2026, residential housing sales in India revealed contrasting trends across major cities. While the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and Bengaluru reported a surge in transactions, Pune and Chennai faced notable declines. A total of 1,14,320 new residential units were introduced in seven cities, with average property prices climbing 7% annually. The approaching festive season is expected to boost the demand for residential properties.

title: Watch: Narrow escape for woman as 300-year-old building collapses in Balasore
content: A two-storey building in Damodarpur, Balasore partially collapsed due to heavy rainfall and weakened structure. This nearly 300-year-old building had historical connections with Fakir Mohan Senapati, an Odia writer and litterateur. People from the family of Bachu Keshab Rao occupied the building over generations and still resided in part of it. Fortunately, there were no injuries or casualties from the incident that blocked a local road.

title: Asian Games: India set up blockbuster hockey semifinal vs arch-rivals Pakistan
content: Defending champions India ended their Asian Games group campaign in style, thrashing Bangladesh 10-0 in a rain-hit match on Monday. Captain Harmanpreet Singh scored a hat-trick as India finished at the top of Pool A. They will now face arch-rivals Pakistan in the semi-final on October 1.

title: UAE signals another $25 billion investment in India; eyes ports, energy and space sectors: Goyal
content: India and the UAE have set a target of doubling bilateral trade to $200 billion by 2032 after trade reached around $100 billion. The target was agreed by the two countries earlier this year.

title: 3 high court chief justices recommended for elevation to Supreme Court
content:
Gujarat, Delhi, Telangana high court CJs recommended for SC elevation

NEW DELHI: The Supreme Court on Monday recommended the elevation of three high court chief justices as judges of the country's top court. The collegium has recommended Gujarat high court chief justice Sunita Agarwal, Delhi high court chief justice Devendra Kumar Upadhyaya and Telangana high court chief justice Aparesh Kumar Singh for elevation to the apex court. The recommendations will now be processed as per the established procedure for appointment of Supreme Court judges.

End of Article

title: UNFPA report: Low wages, poverty, debt drive migrant workers to seek better lives
content: nearly 72% of migrant workers surveyed in three south Indian states felt moving for work has improved their standard of living . more than half (around 57%) intended to continue working in their destination state . over 86% of workers have no signed employment contracts and many face difficulties ranging from accessing welfare to experiencing language, communication and social barriers .

title: No stay on MDR but SC asks under what law was it imposed
content: a bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana argued that MDR charges on UPI transactions would make people revert to cash dealings . govt will not get even a paisa from it, a solicitor general said .

title: US viral delivery driver's $700K fundraiser pulled after daughter posed as neighbour
content: the appeal was created for 81-year-old Donald Johnson . goFundMe's Trust & Safety team found that the organiser was actually the couple's daughter . the campaign organiser had falsely presented herself as a neighbour .

title: SC gives poll panel 3 months to decide on symbol dispute between TMC factions
content: EC asks EC to settle the dispute between Mamata Banerjee-headed Trinamool Congress and the rival faction over the "two flower with grass symbol" in three months . EC gave four weeks to the opposing groups to complete their pleadings and submit evidence to stake claim over the symbol . senior advocate argued the poll panel had taken between six and eight months to decide these matters .

title: FBI adds Goldy Brar to its 10 most wanted list, offers $1 million reward
content: goldy brar is the 543rd fugitive added to the list . he faces multiple federal indictments in the u.s., including racketeer Influenced and Corrupt Organizations (RICO) conspiracy .

title: SC to CBSE: Exempt Class VI from 3-language education policy this year
content: 98.8% of schools have already complied with the new policy . 1.2% of schools not implementing it meant around 300 of them . a bench of chief justice and justices ordered the policy to be implemented for class VI students from the next academic year .

title: UAE confirms Netanyahu’s secret visit; Iran dominated six-hour talks
content: the visit was the first official confirmation from Abu Dhabi of Netanyahu’s trip . the visit focused on strengthening relations between the two countries and on regional challenges . three senior Israeli officials told Reuters that the meeting lasted six hours and focused on Iran .
